headline: Weathered Expanse Seesaw Turns; Callahan's Passage Flares Anew
war_summary: The map has stirred since our last edition. In Weathered Expanse the Wardens have recovered a post, cutting the Colonial lead to six bases against two with one left in ruin; forty-one base actions mark the day, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch the busiest, and firing was logged an hour and a half before press time. Callahan's Passage shows fresh action within the past two hours, the latest minutes before this edition went to wire, leaving the Wardens eight of ten as the twenty-four-hour toll reached 8,345 Colonial and 7,359 Warden. Mooring County, by contrast, has gone quiet on the map — no base actions in eight hours, the Wardens keeping eleven of twelve — though its casualty ledger still runs near ten thousand a side. Stlican Shelf holds its five-four Colonial margin with no change since the small hours, and Palantine Berm, six-one to the Wardens, shows no base actions in six hours yet a sharply climbing casualty pace. On the Nevish Line the day's levy tops 4,700 Colonial and 3,990 Warden, with rates still rising. It is day 380; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
